# Saturday Walk-in Live Scan (California)

> California Live Scan shops that the DOJ list marks as Saturday walk-in, city by city.

Confirm hours and fees with the shop before you go. DOJ says the public list can be stale. Nobody listed here was called.

## Pages

- [Saturday Walk-in Live Scan (California)](https://vinvomero.github.io/saturday-live-scan/): Index of California cities with DOJ-listed Saturday walk-in Live Scan shops. Includes FAQ.
- [Saturday walk-in Live Scan in Oakland](https://vinvomero.github.io/saturday-live-scan/oakland-saturday-walk-in-live-scan/): DOJ-listed Saturday walk-in Live Scan shops in Oakland. Hours, rolling fees, skip list, FAQ.
- [FAQ](https://vinvomero.github.io/saturday-live-scan/faq/): Links to the home and Oakland FAQ sections.
